# HonorRoll

> HonorRoll is a single platform for a school, college, or coaching institution to run code assignments, timed exams, and academic performance tracking — replacing a separate code judge, a separate exam tool, a separate plagiarism checker, and a spreadsheet for tracking who's actually doing well.

Every institution that signs up gets its own fully isolated workspace: own roster, own org structure, own grading rules, never mixed with any other institution's data. Admins manage structure and billing; teachers grade only what's assigned to them, with AI-assisted OCR and plagiarism checks doing the first pass (a human always makes the final call); students write and run code against real test cases, sit proctored exams, and see clear, percentile/grade-band feedback on their own standing.

## Product

- [Home](https://pandadsgn.github.io/HonorRoll/): overview and sign-in
- [About](https://pandadsgn.github.io/HonorRoll/#/about): full feature list — code judging, OCR-scanned handwritten answers, proctored exams, plagiarism signals, performance analytics, custom org structure, bulk roster import, multi-institution accounts
- [Set up an institution](https://pandadsgn.github.io/HonorRoll/#/signup): self-serve signup for a new school/college workspace
- [Changelog](https://pandadsgn.github.io/HonorRoll/#/changelog): recent product updates
